rules: Permanent independence walls survive successful assignment removal/engagement closure. A failed operation that never became an accepted irreversible assignment must not bind a subset of its proposed staff.
Source AccessPopulation.Classify rejects before acceptance and appends independent classification decisions after immutable raw snapshot acceptance.
Direct pre-release contract replacement is allowed; preserve every source/target visibility, active endpoint, exact revision and reason guard when removing aliases.
Identity recovery must automatically complete the exact accepted swap and must register or verify replacement association before revoking old identity.
Concrete attributed frames have finite size, but complete source manifests must not be truncated or artificially capped.

selected.practiceCommit: Acquire all temporary exclusive user/staff reservations plus source use proofs; source owner then writes irreversible EngagementPracticeCommitmentsAuthorized; only then commit all permanent walls and recover forward. Before that authorization, rejection fences source/receivers and releases temporary reservations.
selected.classification: Raw population acceptance does not freeze or require classification; each principal classification reads an exact accepted snapshot proof and keeps local contiguous decision revision.
selected.relationship: One canonical AddApplicationRelationship and RemoveApplicationRelationship; remove overlapping compatibility commands and colliding old discriminator after preserving all their extra guards/reason in canonical handlers and switching consumers.
selected.recovery: Every stage resumes from IdentityRecoveryAccepted. Register/verify returns authoritative existing same-account native proof without append, and the next stage uses that proof without waiting for a new event.
selected.proofWire: Internal command proof carries immutable required-fact content reference; trusted handler verifies native event/digest/content and constructs an expanded typed in-process proof for local aggregate. All nested structured View/Content/Facts content is verified before event publication.

practice.instructions: Which commit point preserves permanent-wall policy and recovery without creating partial permanent walls for a rejected attempt?

criteria.all_reservations_then_authorize: Selected temporary reservation set, source irreversible authorization, then permanent commits with forward recovery.
criteria.commit_as_acquired: Commit permanent walls as each subject is acquired; on a later conflict leave the earlier walls permanently bound.
criteria.release_permanent_on_failure: Commit as acquired, then delete permanent walls if any subject later conflicts.

classification.instructions: Which design preserves the supplied source lifecycle?

criteria.after_acceptance_independent: Selected independently mutable classifications after raw snapshot acceptance.
criteria.classification_before_acceptance: Require classification complete and frozen before snapshot acceptance.

recovery_no_event.instructions: Which continuation handles both fresh and already-associated replacement identity correctly?

criteria.existing_proof_resumes: Selected accepted-recovery process advances from native existing association proof even without append.
criteria.wait_registration_event: Always wait for a new registration event carrying the recovery challenge.

proof_shape.instructions: Which shape preserves exact immutable fact proof and queue frame limits while keeping aggregate decisions free of foreign I/O?

criteria.ref_then_resolve_typed: Selected wire reference verified and expanded into typed internal proof by the server handler.
criteria.embed_every_source_view: Serialize complete cumulative source snapshots directly in every continuation command.
criteria.aggregate_reads_source: Send just source IDs and let aggregate load live source state.
